joint_motion_policy.basis: Operator withdrew the temporary per-axis speed caps. All axes are null: no additional joint-specific speed cap. Existing physical, protocol, measured-speed guard and debug/transition limits remain separately applicable. Protocol VMAX is an encoding range, not a manufacturer operating-speed limit.
